name: sqlite-node
description: Query and manage local SQLite databases.
long_description:
This MCP bundle gives Claude read and write access to a local SQLite database file. You can inspect schemas, run SELECT queries, execute INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE statements, and create or drop tables — all against a SQLite file on your machine.

Capabilities include:
- Listing tables and inspecting their schemas
- Running arbitrary SELECT queries
- Executing INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE statements
- Creating and dropping tables
- Getting database metadata (size, table count, etc.)

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in the SQLite database

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Get the schema (column names, types, constraints) of a table

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run a SELECT query and return results

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Execute an INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or other write statement

tools.name: create_table
tools.description: Create a new table with a specified schema

tools.name: get_database_info
tools.description: Get metadata about the database (size, table count, SQLite version)

database_path.title: SQLite Database File
database_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file (.db or .sqlite). The file will be created if it does not exist.

readonly.title: Read-Only Mode
readonly.description: When enabled, only SELECT queries are allowed. Prevents accidental data modification.
